command: echo ALIVE && git -C C:\cits\repo rev-parse --short HEAD && tasklist | findstr python && echo WAKE_DONE
git -C C:\cits\repo fetch origin claude/continue-kabusute-DmFKB && git -C C:\cits\repo reset --hard FETCH_HEAD && git -C C:\cits\repo log --oneline -1 && echo GIT_OK

schtasks /Create /TN CITS_Watchdog /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\cits\repo\cits\run_watchdog.bat" /SC MINUTE /MO 5 /RL HIGHEST /F & schtasks /Create /TN CITS_VPSAgent /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\cits\repo\cits\run_agent.bat" /SC ONSTART /DELAY 0002:00 /RL HIGHEST /F & schtasks /Create /TN CITS_LiveTrader /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\cits\repo\cits\run_morning.bat" /SC DAILY /ST 08:30 /D MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI /RL HIGHEST /F & schtasks /Create /TN CITS_PositionMonitor /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\cits\repo\cits\run_monitor.bat" /SC MINUTE /MO 30 /ST 09:30 /ET 15:25 /RL HIGHEST /F & schtasks /Create /TN CITS_Afternoon /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\cits\repo\cits\run_afternoon.bat" /SC DAILY /ST 15:20 /D MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI /RL HIGHEST /F & schtasks /Create /TN CITS_Prefetch /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\cits\repo\cits\run_prefetch.bat" /SC DAILY /ST 14:00 /D MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI /RL HIGHEST /F & schtasks /Create /TN CITS_GitRepair /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\cits\repo\cits\run_gitrepair.bat" /SC DAILY /ST 06:00 /D MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI /RL HIGHEST /F & schtasks /Create /TN CITS_StartupRecovery /RU SYSTEM /TR "C:\cits\repo\cits\run_morning.bat" /SC ONSTART /DELAY 0005:00 /RL HIGHEST /F & schtasks /Create /TN CITS_KabuStation_Start /RU Administrator /TR "C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\kabuStation\KabuS.exe" /SC DAILY /ST 08:25 /D MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI /IT /F & echo TASKS_DONE
schtasks /Query /FO CSV /NH 2>&1 | findstr CITS && echo --- && tasklist | findstr python && echo VERIFY_DONE
